en: The image depicts a colorized street scene, likely from the early 20th century, showing a group of people, many of them children, gathered on a wide, slightly uphill street lined with buildings on both sides. Some buildings have awnings and large windows, while the street is shaded by leafless trees, suggesting late autumn or early spring. The architecture, with its flat roofs and the design of the windows, hints at a Mediterranean or Balkan influence.
